title: illusion-image-index: an index of visual-illusion images on the web, with labels and licences
description: Metadata for 47,413 pictures (60,362 source records from 29 web sources) collected as candidate visual-illusion images, each labelled illusion / not an illusion / trick art / unsure, with perceptual categories for 11,421 illusion pictures, source URLs, authors and normalised licences, and two blind human checks. Images whose licence allows redistribution and that passed a repost screen are bundled separately by licence. Code: MIT. Metadata and labels: CC BY 4.0. Images: their own licences.
